messages:
Eli (Finance): quick help — I'm seeing 312 GPU-hours on ledger GA-98765 billed to project-playground (internal project id playground-prod). This month's invoice INV-3492 shows $18,720 charged to cost center 'self-serve'. Team claims it should be billed to 'dedicated-redwood-batch'. Anyone know mapping?
Jordan (Infra): I can take a look. Do you have the GCE labels or the VM instance IDs? Usually untagged VMs default to 'self-serve'.
Eli (Finance): here's the vm tags returned by billing export for that day:
```
resource.labels.instance_id: "i-04ab3c"
labels: {"env":"prod","team":"playground"}
```
Priya (ML Platform): That instance id belongs to a transient notebook launcher we rolled out — shouldn't be on dedicated pool. Could be a misconfigured service account launching VMs in the wrong project.
Rashida (SRE): We have a migration script that spins up worker pools; last deploy had a typo in project id. Pinged infra earlier, @Jordan.
Jordan (Infra): Confirmed — deploy used project 'project-playground' instead of 'dedicated-redwood-batch' in the autoscaler template. Fix pushed at 16:12 UTC. Will backfill tags and ask for credits.
Eli (Finance): Thanks. What's ETA for credits/adjustment? We need this before month-end close. Also need the list of affected invoices/lines so I can file a vendor dispute.
Jordan (Infra): I'll assemble a list. quick SQL I ran to find suspect lines:
```
SELECT invoice_id, project_id, sku, usage_hours
FROM billing_export
WHERE resource.labels.instance_id IN ('i-04ab3c','i-07d2ef')
  AND DATE(invoice_period_start) >= '2026-03-01';
```
Priya (ML Platform): I'm listing owners and confirming whether those were ephemeral notebooks or long-running jobs. I think only two projects affected.
billing-bot: New vendor invoice INV-3492 uploaded by billing@vendor.com — linked in #finance
Eli (Finance): Cool. Once you have the list, tag the PR with #credit-request and CC me. Also add a short note: 'misrouted project due to autoscaler template typo'. :pray:
Rashida (SRE): FYI adding a CI check to the deploy pipeline to validate project ids and a preflight to prevent future misroutes.
Eli (Finance): Perfect. Can we also add a metric alert for monthly GPU-hours per project > 200 to catch spikes early? @Priya
Priya (ML Platform): Yep, I'll add an alert and a dashboard panel. will ping when done.
Jordan (Infra): Sending the CSV to Eli shortly. :email:
Eli (Finance): Thanks all — setting calendar reminder to follow up on credits next Tue.
